meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 用户要求迁移旧记忆时，Claude 会先定位旧格式记忆文件并暂停相关任务，再把这些内容分类融入统一的记忆树和常驻指令；它不跟随符号链接，完成后给出来源与去向报告，等你确认才算结束。
howto.when: 当更新后提示记忆结构不兼容、群组里还残留 .seed.md 或 CLAUDE.md 等旧文件，或你说“migrate memory”这类话时触发。

say.text: 把项目里的旧记忆迁移到新位置
say.note: 会处理 CLAUDE.md 等遗留文件。

say.text: CLAUDE.md 里的行为准则请转成常驻指令
刚才更新后它好像忘了所有事
say.note: 会检查并迁移遗留记忆。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude finds and stages legacy memory files, pauses tasks, organizes content into the unified memory tree and standing instructions, ignores symlinks, and reports each source-to-destination move for approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, when a group still has legacy files like .seed.md or CLAUDE.md, or when you say prompts such as 'migrate memory'.

say_en.text: Please migrate the project's old memory to the new location
Turn the behavior rules in CLAUDE.md into standing instructions
It seems to have forgotten everything after the update
